reviews.text: Our dog, Colt, has been with Michelle at Pets4Vets since he was a puppy as the practice moved from Newton Mearns to Pollokshaws (Colt is now 10). We moved to Kilmarnock and have stayed with the practice as the level of care is unbelievable. Last couple of times, we’ve seen Amy Finlay and honestly she is absolutely outstanding and unbelievably kind both to the pets and the owners. Colt has been really unwell across the last week and our appointment today, she really took her time to check over him, go through the care options ensuring we were going down the best route, explained what to expect over the next couple of days and what we should look out for if we need to bring him back in. Amy is so kind and you can tell she loves her job and the animals she is caring for. Reception staff today also could not be any nicer. A huge thank you to everyone at this practice for managing to see us last minute. Could not recommend you all enough and so lucky our dog has the best vet care 💕 xx

Just a wee note to thank Vets4Pets Pollokshaws staff for their great work. My cat Rubble had minor surgery recently, as stressful as it was (for both of us!) everyone made the experience really smooth. Vets gave thorough explanations before and after, and were happy to share lab results. The nurses were absolutely great, both on the day (special thanks to Emma for being extra sweet with Rubble, so much appreciated! And also for sorting out the insurance claim) and on post-op check ups. Reception staff are always polite, professional, and honestly just really nice people. Thank you all :)

We have been registered at Vets4pets for 3 years now. From initial sign up right up until today we have always had top class service. All members of staff clearly care about the animals and aren’t just in it for the money. We have 3 cats and have never had an issue, 1 cat has been in for a couple of procedures and when home it’s clear she loved the attention the nurses/vets gave her! I never worry if I have to leave any of them there as they are in capable and loving hands. We moved out of the area recently and are now nearly 20 miles away but have stayed registered at the Pollokshaws branch as we have been impressed with the service so much and don’t want to risk registering anywhere else that’s not as good!
Excellent care shown, would highly recommend this Veterinary practice

Michelle and everyone that works at Vets for Pets Pollokshaws are brilliant. My 12 year springer spaniel has been with Vets for Pets since she was a puppy and unfortunately she needed an operation to remove bladder stones. Needless to say my husband and I were worried about the operation given our dogs age. Michelle did the op and she was amazing. Our dog had the best care - pre op, during the op and post op. The whole team were knowledge and very caring and kept us informed every step of the way. I thoroughly recommend Vets for Pets, they are great!
It’s been a real pleasure coming in and working with Emma. Nala has made fantastic progress in her weight loss journey, she’s now more active and happier, which is lovely to see.

Our dog was very unwell as she hadn’t eaten for a couple of days. When she was out her walks her poo was very runny. She was very lethargic and slept a lot throughout the days. She was also being sick!
We phoned the vets and managed to make an appointment for today. The vet who saw our dog was Amy. She examined our dog thoroughly and  decided to give her an injection to stop the sickness and also some paste which we have to administer to help calm our dog’s stomach. Hopefully these medications will help our dog’s recovery. If we are at all anxious we can phone the vets if our dog’s recovery isn’t responding to the medication.

Absolutely awful service - was on health plan flr my pet.  They try to charge you for service when plan includes vet and nurse visits.  One staff say something os included in plan and anothr says it isn't and try to charge you.  Supposed to get flea and worm but cause my cat was pregnant they refused to give me a alternative suitable for pregnant cat...so even though ita supposed to be part of plan I had to source my own. They also got dates mixed up and refused to provide me for my cats last month.  They also dont give reminders as their supposed to.  Say a treatment is part of a plan and then you go for that they say it isnt and try to charge you. Supposed to have 2 vet visits as part of plan but then try to chatmrge you for the service aliasing that isnt part of the plan.  Absolutely underhand service.  Avoid at all cost.
It’s all about the cash. It’s not the staff as they are great. It’s the company that owns them and it’s driven by insurance also.
Very friendly and helpful service, I have been using this vet for the past year and a half and I have not had one issue.
I got my pup Woody vaccinated health check up wormed and flea & tick treatment here all the staff are lovely with pure professionalism.
So far so good. You can tell the vets and nurses really care, they usually do but in other places there’s often a paywall taking priority
